Added: Auth: basic/bearer/apikey/oauth2/oauth1/digest/ntlm/awsv4/hawk are now converted into a native auth block instead of only basic/bearer/apikey being flattened into headers

Pre-request and test scripts are imported as commented-out pre_script/post_script blocks (Postman's pm.* API isn't translated automatically since Voiden scripts use a different voiden.*/vd.* API — review and adapt before enabling)
Multipart form-data file fields (type: file) are imported as fileLink attachments when the file still exists at its original path on this machine, instead of being silently dropped
GraphQL request bodies (body.mode: graphql) are converted into gqlquery/gqlvariables blocks instead of being skipped
Changed: Completion state no longer leaves the import button stuck green — it now shows a check icon with a brief "Completed"-style message for 2 seconds (plus a toast notification) before resetting to idle

Added: Colon-style path segments (e.g. :id) in request URLs are converted to brace-style placeholders (e.g. {id})
Path parameters are extracted from Postman's url.variable list (or inferred from :name segments when absent) and imported as a path-table block with their values
Postman environment and globals exports can now be imported directly — enabled variables are written into the project's .env files, using the environment name as the comment header
